It sells the design for me.","avatar_url":""},{"name":"Rajiv M.","role":"Marketing Director","content":"We needed holiday-themed marketing materials fast. Instead of reshooting our products, we just prompted 'Christmas morning vibe' in Lovart, and our products were placed in the perfect festive scene.","avatar_url":""}]},{"type":"faqSection","faq":[{"question":"Can I use my own logo files?","answer":"Yes, you can upload your own PNG, SVG, or JPG logo files to your Brand Kit or directly onto the canvas. The result is a photorealistic image that looks like it was taken in a professional studio."},{"question":"Does it work for apparel?","answer":"Absolutely. Apparel is one of our strongest use cases. description: Instantly apply your brand identity to real-world products. Use Lovart's AI Design Agent to generate photorealistic mockups for packaging, apparel, and digital devices directly from your Brand Kit.
